editorial.name: Freebies.ByPeople
editorial.descriptionZh: 面向设计师与开发者的商用免费素材合集，按类型列成一张长分类表，同时还推销自家的插画、图标与 3D 素材包。
editorial.takeawayZh: 按分类翻商用可用的免费素材，顺带看它自家的插画与图标包
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是红底拼贴插画，右侧白字是 Freebies.| ByPeople 与一句 A professionally curated selection of commercial use resources and tools for designers and developers，下面挂着一枚 #2 ProductHunt PRODUCT OF THE DAY 徽章和 Facebook、Twitter 分享图标。再往下标题变成 Have a quick look at some of our products:，一排铺开 Artify Illustrations、3D Lettering Pack、3D Icons Pack、Gradientify Icons Pack、Iconshock Premium、3D Illustrations Pack、ByPeople Bundle 等自家产品。页面底部才是分类表：Graphic、UI Kits、E-Books、HTML Themes、3D Models、WP Plugins、Fonts、Icons、Code Snippets、Sound Effects、Motion Graphics、Presentations & Infographics 等，旁边一个 SUBMIT 入口。

reasons.statement: description 写 A selection of free-for-comercial-use resources for designers and developers, conveniently collected and categorized in one place，站点的角色是把素材收拢分类、再导向下载。
页面主体是一张按类型平铺的分类长表（UI Kits、HTML Themes、3D Models、Sound Effects 等）加一个 SUBMIT 入口，符合素材目录形态。
